newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Nov household savings up 55.7 bln forints.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Nov household savings up 55.7 bln forints.

text.p: Hungary's net household savings rose 55.7 billion forints in November to 2,344.8 billion forints, the National Bank of Hungary said on Wednesday.
NOTE - Figures are not inflation adjusted. This year's figures are preliminary. The consumer price inflation was 20.1 percent year-on-year in October. ($1=164.09 forints.)
The NBH said that the nominal value of net household savings rose by 29.4 percent between December 31, 1995 and the end of November, while in real terms the rise amounted to 9.2 percent. @

Households continued to prefer bank deposits in November, the NBH added. The stock of bank deposits rose by 19 billion forints in November, compared with an increase of 17.3 billion in securities, the NBH said. The stock of cash rose by 14.6 billion forints in November.
